titleZh: 誠實 ↔ 欺瞞｜玻璃心 vs 煙霧彈
script: 誠實隊：frank／artless／aboveboard。欺瞞隊：duplicitous／underhanded／sly——主持人：aboveboard peeks＝沒有偷看；underhanded swaps 零分。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 坦率麥: frank walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「坦率麥」出場：frank 一上場梗就黏住——坦率。

members.senseAnchor: characterized by an inability to mask your feelings; not devious; simple and natural; without cunning or deceit

members.senseAnchor: marked by deliberate deceptiveness especially by pretending one set of feelings and acting under the influence of another; - Israel Zangwill; ; - W.M.Thackeray
